title: 36 Hours in Tokyo
abstract: Think of Tokyo as a warren of concealed gems: Wander down side streets and be richly rewarded.

title: 36 Hours in Las Vegas
abstract: A well-rounded tour of Vegas requires going beyond the Strip: What you find may surprise you.

title: 36 Hours in Lisbon
abstract: The charm of the maritime city’s colorful-tile-wrapped facades and hilly, sun-warmed streets remains strong, even as it enjoys a popularity boom.

title: 36 Hours in Philadelphia
abstract: Spring is synonymous with street festivals, but the city’s historic charm, world-class art and passionate cheesesteak discourse are year-round.
